memory_initialization: current class mean + .1*N(0,I)/sqrt(d), seed+1000+class; ball projected; identical all arms
decision_objective: mean sliced W1 of 4D pre/post joint seen/reserved margins divided by beta + mean relative squared CE adapter-gradient error across pre/post snapshots
slot_assignment: fixed 0..K-1 shared across all four arms; no Hungarian
frame: global fixed random-orientation ETF capacity K; seed+2000
scope: Rebuild task1 once per scale; construct moment and decision once; fixed post-task1 teacher, no task2 update, no independent evaluation
diagnostics: classwise old/expanded CE gradients, expanded-minus-old competition gradients, U/V components and macro cancellation, signed seen/reserve margin weighted empirical distributions and exact W1
queries: old=range(task_sizes[0]); expanded=range(sum(task_sizes[:2])); no future image/label samples used
gradient_relative_error: L2 error / reference L2 norm; denominator <=1e-12 gives null, absolute value always reported
response_distribution: all weighted empirical atoms published; quantiles and abs margin<=0.25 mass; argmax coverage measured directly; no tuning
decision_rule: descriptive paired class counts and macro errors only; no efficacy gate or new model selection; contradictory/mixed results retained
state_persistence: one private postconstruction synthetic state per scale before diagnostics; no raw gradient tensors public
